title.en: The One With the Madrid Apartment

description.es: Marta va a la tienda y Fina bromea diciendo que, como no hay nadie, quizá pueda acercarse. Marta ha alquilado un piso en Madrid para que puedan quedarse allí. Le regala a Fina las llaves del piso, y Fina, llena de alegría, la cubre de besos. Damián llama a Marta a casa, le pregunta por el piso que ha alquilado en Madrid y discuten. Entonces llega Jaime.
description.en: Marta comes to the store. Fina jokes that, since no one is around, she might come closer. Marta has rented an apartment in Madrid so that they can stay there. She gives Fina the keys to the apartment as a gift, and Fina, overjoyed, showers her with kisses. Damián summons Marta home, asks her about the apartment she rented in Madrid, and they argue. Then Jaime arrives.
